page.overview:
What is Gothita?

Gothita is a small Pokémon with the appearance of a baby. It has a large, rounded purple head, big blue eyes with three visible eyelashes on each, and large pink lips. It has three white bow-like adornments, located on the sides of its head and its neck. The top of its head is black with a rounded upright ovular antenna-like feeler sprouting from the very top. It has a slightly pudgy little black body with stubby arms and legs and a white zigzagging pattern across its belly. It slightly resembles Smoochum.

Gothita are often seen staring intently at everything, including Pokémon and people. It appears that it can see something in a mystical dimension that cannot be seen by human eyes. It can become so entranced by what it is watching that it does not notice that it is being attacked by an opponent.

Gothita's bow-like feelers enable it to increase its psychic powers.

Gothita evolves into Gothorita starting at level 32 and then evolves into Gothitelle starting at level 41.
